$comment: 听力训练营 L42（P-L4 阶段四，三 Part 混合课=真考前三部分，15 题）。脚本 100% 原创；按真考顺序 Part 1 → Part 2 → Part 3：Part 1 五段短对话选图（难度按 L10）+ Part 2 烹饪班通知一段独白 5 空（难度按 L20：姓名拼读 L-A-M-B-E-R-T、星期、时间、价格、要带的东西）+ Part 3 Ella 和 Dan 聊烹饪班 5 题观点态度（难度按 L35：综合前后两句）。一课一场景=学做饭。词汇 ≥95% 落在 KET A2 词表，超出的词进 warmup。语速 1.0x。
title: Learning to Cook
intro: 真考的前三部分连着做，15 题：先 5 道选图（先做什么菜、几点上课、买什么、食谱书多少钱、在哪儿吃），再听学校烹饪班的通知填 5 个空（老师姓名拼读、星期、结束时间、六周价格、要带什么），最后听 Ella 和 Dan 聊烹饪班（为什么报名、老师怎么样、第一节课感受、煎饼去哪了、下周做什么——前后两句合起来想）。Part 之间只有一句过渡，做完大约 15 分钟。

sections.intro: Part 1 开始。听一段短对话，选出正确的图。三个选项都会出现，抓住最后定下来的那个。

script.text: Welcome to the cooking class. We were going to make pizza today, but the big oven is broken.
Can we make a cake in the small oven, then?
Cake is next week. Today we'll make pasta with tomato sauce, we only need the cooker for that.
Great, I love pasta.

questions.q: What will the class make today?
questions.explain: 披萨因为烤箱坏了做不了，蛋糕是下周（next week），今天 we'll make pasta with tomato sauce。

sections.intro: 听一段短对话，选出正确的图。

script.text: Dan, is the cooking class at four today, like always?
No, Mrs Lambert has a meeting. It starts at half past four today.
Oh, I thought it was half past three. That's what Ruby said.
Ruby got it wrong. Half past four, in the school kitchen.

questions.q: What time does the cooking class start today?
questions.explain: 四点是平时（like always），三点半是 Ruby 说错的，今天 It starts at half past four = 4:30。

sections.intro: 听一段短对话，选出正确的图。

script.text: Mum, I want to make pancakes tonight. Have we got eggs?
There are six eggs in the fridge, and there's flour. But we haven't got any milk.
I'll go to the shop, then. Shall I get apples for the pancakes too?
There are apples in the bowl. Just the milk, please.

questions.q: What does Dan need to buy?
questions.explain: 鸡蛋有六个，苹果碗里有，没有的是牛奶：Just the milk, please。

sections.intro: 听一段短对话，选出正确的图。

script.text: Dad, can I buy this cooking book? It was fifteen pounds, but it's in the sale now.
How much is it now?
Ten pounds. The small one is eight, but it only has cakes in it.
OK, the big one for ten. You can cook me dinner on Sunday.

questions.q: How much does the cooking book cost now?
questions.explain: 十五镑是原价（It was），八镑是小本的，现在 Ten pounds → the big one for ten = £10。

sections.intro: 听一段短对话，选出正确的图。

script.text: Our pasta is ready. Let's take it to the park and eat it there.
It's raining, Dan. What about the café next to school?
You can't take your own food into a café. Mrs Lambert says we can eat in the school kitchen.
OK, here in the kitchen, then. Pass me a fork.

questions.q: Where will Dan and Ella eat their pasta?
questions.explain: 公园下雨，咖啡馆不能自带食物，最后 we can eat in the school kitchen → OK, here in the kitchen。

sections.intro: Part 2 开始。听学校烹饪班的通知，把笔记补全。五个空：老师姓名拼读、星期、结束时间、价格、要带的东西。每个空前后都有一个干扰。

script.text: Hello, everyone. Here is some news about the new cooking class for children. The teacher is Mrs Lambert. That's L-A-M-B-E-R-T. She was a cook in a hotel for ten years.
The class was going to be on Saturday, but the school kitchen is full on Saturdays. So the class is every Wednesday after school.
It starts at four o'clock and finishes at half past five. The kitchen closes at six, so please leave by then.
The class costs twenty pounds for six weeks. That's cheaper than four pounds a week. The money is for the food you cook, and you take the food home.
You don't need to bring a bowl or a knife, the kitchen has everything. But please bring an old shirt to wear, because cooking can be dirty. See you on Wednesday.

questions.explain: The teacher is Mrs Lambert. That's L-A-M-B-E-R-T，照拼读写。
was going to be on Saturday, but… full on Saturdays. So the class is every Wednesday——是周三。
finishes at half past five = 5:30。six 是厨房关门的时间。
costs twenty pounds for six weeks = £20。four pounds a week 是用来比较的。
don't need to bring a bowl or a knife… But please bring an old shirt to wear——要带的是旧衬衫。

sections.intro: Part 3 开始。听 Ella 和 Dan 聊烹饪班。五道题的答案都要把前后两句合起来想：前一句常是「别人的看法」或「困难」，后一句才是真正的原因和感受。

script.text: Ella, why did you join the cooking class? Was it your mum's idea?
Mum said it was a good idea, and Ruby joined too. But the big thing is that Mum works all week, and I want to make dinner for the family on Sundays. Something better than sandwiches.
That's a good idea. What do you think of Mrs Lambert?
Some people say she talks too much. What do you think?
She does explain everything twice, that's true. But when my sauce went wrong last week, she came over and showed me what to do, and she never gets angry. I think she's great.
Me too. How did you feel in the first lesson? I was so worried before it started. I had never cut an onion in my life.
Really? You looked fine to me.
After ten minutes I was fine. And my pasta was delicious, Dad ate two plates. So I'm not worried any more.
My pancakes were good too, on Wednesday. I made eight, and not one of them burned.
Did your sister like them? You said you'd take them home for her.
I wanted to. But Sam's and Ruby's pancakes were black, and they had nothing to eat. So I gave them mine. My sister can have some next time.
That was kind. What are we cooking next week? Mrs Lambert said pizza at the start of term.
It was going to be pizza. But the big oven is still broken, so she said we'll make a cake in the small oven. Pizza will be after that.
Cake is fine by me. I'll bring the eggs.

questions.q: Why did Ella join the cooking class?
options: She wants to cook for her family.
questions.explain: 前一句 Mum said it was a good idea, and Ruby joined too（妈妈和朋友都只是原因之一）+ 后一句 But the big thing is… I want to make dinner for the family on Sundays——真正的原因是想给家人做饭。

questions.q: What does Dan think about Mrs Lambert?
questions.explain: 前一句 Some people say she talks too much… She does explain everything twice（承认话多）+ 后一句 But when my sauce went wrong… she came over and showed me… never gets angry. I think she's great——他觉得老师很会帮人。

questions.q: How did Ella feel about the first lesson?
options: She was worried before it started.
It was too easy for her.
questions.explain: I was so worried before it started. I had never cut an onion + After ten minutes I was fine——开始前很担心，后来才好。

questions.q: Why didn't Dan take his pancakes home?
options: He ate them all at school.
He gave them to his friends.
questions.explain: 前一句 I made eight, and not one of them burned… I wanted to（没糊、也想带回家）+ 后一句 But Sam's and Ruby's pancakes were black… So I gave them mine——送给了朋友。

questions.q: What will the class cook next week?
questions.explain: 前一句 Mrs Lambert said pizza… It was going to be pizza（原计划）+ 后一句 But the big oven is still broken, so… we'll make a cake in the small oven——下周做蛋糕。
